note: head.stl, middle.stl, tail.stl are in one frame forming a 1-segment dragon. For N segments: middle copy k (k=0..N-1) is translated by k*pitch; tail is translated by (N-1)*pitch.

spiral.note: max bend per joint and spacing between spiral turns. seg-seg joint keeps 0.37mm gap to +-8deg, ~0.25 at 10, touches by 16; tail similar. Head joint has ~0 side play so the head stays straight. arm_gap 26 leaves >=0.4mm between turns (24 overlapped spike tips).
